note: Thresholds for workload rules R-IOT-1, R-FH-1, R-BR-1, R-BR-2, R-FH-2, R-ATH-1, R-ATH-2, R-SM-1, R-COST-1. Every value carries its evidence level: '실험 확인' (reproduced in this repository's synthetic experiments), '공식 자료' (AWS documentation or price list, checked 2026-11-13), '임시값' (provisional; re-derive from real account data).

kb_definitions_bytes.source: AWS IoT Core pricing: messages metered in 5 KB increments; byte definition unconfirmed, so both are evaluated (experiment 016)

batch_size_limit_bytes.source: 5% margin under the 5,000 B boundary (experiment 016 H3)

metering_tolerance.source: allowed relative gap between metered and expected metered messages

record_unit_bytes.source: Amazon Data Firehose pricing: billed per GB ingested in 5KB increments

supported_profiles.source: Only Global cross-Region rates for Claude were found in the Seoul price list

ttl_seconds.source: Amazon Bedrock prompt caching: 5 minute TTL, 1 hour option

min_cache_tokens.source: Bedrock prompt caching supported-models table; Sonnet 4.5 not listed (null = unknown)

min_observed_cache_writes.source: minimum cache-write calls before judging a hit ratio

object_count_tolerance.source: allowed relative gap between observed and modeled daily object count

min_billed_mb.source: AWS Glue pricing page, Athena: rounded up to the nearest megabyte, 10 MB minimum per query

min_queries.source: minimum successful DML queries before judging a table

parquet_scan_reduction.source: experiment 018: smallest CSV-to-Parquet reduction among queries/layouts (local proxy, not Athena)

serverless_cost_share.source: serverless must cost less than this share of the endpoint to become a candidate

hours_per_month.source: experiment 022 month length; used to prorate training volume storage

window_days.real_account_check: 실제 계정 점검(experiment 023): 보류 - 2월 효과가 창 길이의 절반(14일) 동안 지속

mad_k.source: experiment 021: selected on tuning seeds, test spike recall 97.8%, 0.040 false alarms per 30 normal days
mad_k.real_account_check: 실제 계정 점검(experiment 023): 보류 - 경보가 모두 MAD=0 시계열에서 발생해 k가 관여하지 않음

min_relative_increase.real_account_check: 실제 계정 점검(experiment 023): 보류 - 월 고정 요금의 2월 일수 효과(+10.7%)가 하한을 넘어 14일 연속 오탐

exclude_alerts.source: experiment 021: excluding alert days ran away after a level shift (0.040 -> 0.50 false alarms per 30 days)
exclude_alerts.real_account_check: 실제 계정 점검(experiment 023): 유지 - 기본값으로 실행

consecutive_cap_days.source: required when exclude_alerts is true; after this many consecutive alert days, alert days rejoin the baseline
